SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN pollutant_type = 'PM2.5' THEN value END) AS pm25Avg, AVG(CASE WHEN pollutant_type = 'PM10' THEN value END) AS pm10Avg, AVG(CASE WHEN pollutant_type = 'SO2' THEN value END) AS so2Avg, AVG(CASE WHEN pollutant_type = 'NO2' THEN value END) AS no2Avg, AVG(CASE WHEN pollutant_type = 'O3' THEN value END) AS o3Avg FROM pollutant_data
AND city = #{city}

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN pollutant_type = 'PM2.5' AND value <= 75 THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) FROM pollutant_data WHERE pollutant_type = 'PM2.5'
AND city = #{city}
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT city) FROM pollutant_data WHERE pollutant_type = 'PM2.5' AND value <= 75
SELECT city, value AS value, pollutant_type AS pollutantType FROM pollutant_data WHERE pollutant_type = 'PM2.5' ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT city, pollutant_type AS pollutantType, DATE_FORMAT(date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, value AS concentration FROM pollutant_data ORDER BY date DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
